predictions.claim: On a verified CPU-only host (no GPU device nodes, no GPU kernel modules), a 7B-8B Q4_K_M seat served by llama.cpp/ollama sustains generation throughput in the band 1–15 tokens/s, measured over >=200 generated tokens by the engine's own timing report or wall-clock.
predictions.modal_band: 3–8 tokens/s on a modern >=8-core consumer CPU; up to 15 on high-core-count desktops
predictions.measurement: engine timing fields (ollama /api/generate eval_count/eval_duration; llama-server timings) or wall-clock over >=200 generated tokens, receipted in the run bundle
predictions.falsified_if: measured >= 15 tokens/s on a host whose CPU-only status is receipted (would mean the hardware was misclassified or the engine's report is wrong — either is an incident)
predictions.honest_concern: < 1 token/s sustained would make the 8000-token witness budgets impractical on CPU class; that is a measured curve point, not a falsification

predictions.claim: On a single consumer GPU with >= 8 GiB VRAM, the same 7B-8B Q4_K_M seat sustains generation throughput >= 20 tokens/s (band 20–120; modal 35–70) with the model fully resident in VRAM.
predictions.measurement: same fields as S1 plus nvidia-smi residency check (model not spilling to shared/system memory)
predictions.falsified_if: measured < 20 tokens/s while nvidia-smi is present, the model is fully VRAM-resident, and the GPU is not thermally throttled

predictions.claim: A Q4_K_M 7B-8B model (4.1–4.9 GB weights) plus KV cache for an 8000-token context does NOT run usefully (i.e. not >= 5 tokens/s) inside a 4 GiB memory cgroup (this lane's sandbox: memory.max = 4294967296) — mmap can keep it from OOM but throughput collapses to thrash.
predictions.measurement: load + generate attempt inside the cgroup with /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max receipted; count OOM kills, swap/mmap page faults, tokens/s
predictions.falsified_if: a <= 4 GiB cgroup runs the full seat at >= 5 tokens/s with an 8000-token context (would falsify the '4 GiB cannot host it' design assumption — and this sandbox would then be a usable G1 host after all)

predictions.claim: The first successful seat run produces a g7-watt-receipt@1 that scripts/g7_validate.mjs accepts (exit 0) with energy.source ∈ {measured, estimated, tdp_derived}; if measured, energy.instrument names nvidia-smi NVML / RAPL / a wall-meter; if estimated or tdp_derived, energy.derivation shows the arithmetic; determinism.state_digest binds the responses bundle; gate.rule is the verbatim registered rule.
predictions.measurement: node scripts/g7_validate.mjs <receipt> exit code + reasons, receipted in the run bundle
predictions.falsified_if: the first receipt is refused (exit 1), or a seat verdict ships without a valid receipt (that is a G7-law incident: spend without receipts = VOID), or the receipt contains a number nobody can derive from a named instrument/derivation

predictions.claim: Two identical seat calls (same prompt, temperature 0, same fixed seed, same engine build, same hardware, same thread count, single-stream greedy path) produce byte-identical output text.
predictions.measurement: harness runs the same prompt twice back-to-back in one process session, sha256-compares the raw outputs, receipts build + thread count + seed alongside
predictions.falsified_if: any byte differs between the two outputs under the fixed single-stream path — the difference then becomes a first-class G2 determinism finding with the minimal reproducer receipted (nondeterminism is default on the fast substrate; finding it is the product, not a failure)
predictions.honest_scope: server-side batching, thread-count changes, or build changes void the comparison scope; the harness records all three so a mismatch is diagnosable rather than mysterious

predictions.claim: For the same 7B-8B model at temperature 0, the Q4_K_M build's output diverges from the FP16 build's output (first differing token) within the first 200 generated tokens on >= 1 of 20 certified fixed prompts; and across quant levels Q8_0 → Q4_K_M → Q4_0 → Q2_K the divergence rate (prompts with any divergence / 20) is weakly monotone increasing as bit-width narrows — the output-level analogue of E-Q10's monotone re-erosion (G3 link).
predictions.measurement: 20 certified prompts x {FP16, Q8_0, Q4_K_M, Q4_0, Q2_K} at temp 0, first-divergence-token index recorded per prompt per level; curves committed like G3's erosion registry
predictions.falsified_if: Q4_K_M is token-identical to FP16 on all 20 prompts (output-level erosion invisible — a finding against the folklore that Q4 visibly degrades), or the Q8_0/Q4_K_M/Q4_0/Q2_K ordering inverts cleanly across >= 3 consecutive level pairs (would contradict the monotone-erosion analogy and need its own registry entry)

predictions.claim: Operationalization of carried-playbook-P1: the certified chamber-class prompt battery (96-prompt class) completes >= 80% of prompts within a per-prompt 8000-token generation budget on the GPU-class seat (the 45-c starvation constraint — deepseek died at 0/96 @ 2000 — becomes a measured completion-rate curve in budget, not a binary kill).
predictions.measurement: completion rate = prompts answered within budget / prompts attempted, per budget step {2000, 4000, 8000}, receipted per prompt
predictions.falsified_if: completion < 80% at the 8000-token budget on the GPU-class seat (the seat then fails the same witness-claims bar the API seat failed — honest KILL of record per the playbook acceptance rule)
predictions.note: on CPU-class the same battery may be run at reduced N; the 8000-budget completion claim is only adjudicated on GPU-class hardware
